प्रथम [prathama], [प्रथ्-अमच्] (Nom. pl. m. प्रथमे or प्रथमाः)
First, foremost; मखांशभाजां प्रथमो मनीषिभिस्त्वमेव देवेन्द्र सदा निगद्यसे
First, chief, principal, most excellent or eminent, matchless, incomparable; Śi.15.42; एष वै प्रथमः कल्पः प्रदाने हव्यकव्ययोः
Prior, previous, former, earlier; प्रथमसुकृता- पेक्षया
(In gram.) The first person (= third person according to European phraseology).
The first consonant of a class.
(In math.) The sum of the products divided by the difference between the squares of the cosine of the azimuth and the sine of the amplitude. -मा The nominative case. -मम् ind.
first, firstly, at first; उमास्तनो- द्भेदमनुप्रवृद्धो मनोरथो यः प्रथमं बभूव
Already, previously, formerly; प्रथमोदितम् aforesaid; तमभ्यनन्दत् प्रथमं प्रबोधितः प्रजेश्वरः शासनहारिणा हरेः

an excellent suggestion or idea. -कल्पित a.
first in rank or importance. -कुसुमः white marjoran. -गर्भः a. pregnant for the first time,-गिरिः the Eastern mountain; द्वित्रेषु द्युमणिकरेषु शेखरत्वं प्राप्तेषु प्रथमगिरिः प्रयाति सो$यम् Rām.

प्रथा [prathā], Fame, celebrity; अतः श्रियः पतिरिति प्रथामगाः Śi.15.27.

प्रथु [prathu], a. Wide, wide-spread. -थुः An epithet of Viṣṇu.
प्रथुकः [prathukḥ], Rice parched and flattened (of. पृथुक); (Mar. पोहे).
